name: manual_b33c66
claim: resolve_sibling_git_repo.sh's sibling_repo_is_git_root() treats any 0-byte regular file named .git as a valid sibling git root (uses [[ -e .../.git ]] existence-only, excluding only symlinks) — false-positives on uv's sdist cache marker files and blocks pushes with a bogus DIVERGENCE finding

decisions.notes: Confirmed 11 instances under /private<local-tmp-file>/sdists-v9/, each a 0-byte plain regular file, none a real git repo ([ -d .../.git ] false for all 11). Blocked push of PT PR #355 with 'DIVERGENCE: sdists-v9 vs canonical' until GUARD_SYNC_SKIP_DIVERGENCE_CHECK=1 was used for that one push, deliberately, after proof the flagged sibling wasn't real. This is a canonical (orama-system) bug in manifest-managed tooling — needs an upstream fix (e.g. require -d or valid gitdir: content), not a downstream hand-patch. Not yet fixed anywhere; flagging for future pickup.
